Subject: Finlytics POC: success criteria & kickoff plan

Hi Sofia + Diego — great speaking with you today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned heading into the pilot: 

Summary of objective:
- Validate Redwood Inference for Finlytics’ document ingest + search pipeline with a focus on latency, recall on key queries, and cost per 1k tokens.

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
1) Ingest ~200k docs (subset) and verify indexing/embedding accuracy.
2) Measure 95th percentile latency for live query workload (target < 300ms).
3) Run evaluation set of 250 queries vs. your baseline for relevance / recall (target +15% improvement).
4) Track cost metrics and provide optimization recommendations (batching/quantization).

Success criteria (attach: Finlytics_POC_Success_Criteria.md):
- Accuracy: >15% lift on relevance at top-3 vs current baseline.
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for production-like queries.
- Stability: no more than 2% error/timeout rate across runs.
- Operational: ability to route requests between hosted & dedicated configs without changes to your integration.

Timeline & ownership:
- Week of 2/23: Kickoff & infra validation (Finlytics: Diego — data access + sample dataset; Redwood: Dev — infra setup, Laura — onboarding/runbooks)
- Week of 3/2: Ingest + first evaluation run
- End of week 3/2: Results review + optimization recommendations

Action items for Finlytics (please confirm):
- Provide sample dataset (S3 or Drive) by 2/20.
- Confirm a technical point-of-contact for infra/network (Diego listed).
- Confirm any restricted columns/data redaction we should apply.

Attachments: Finlytics_POC_Success_Criteria.md, POC_Timeline.xlsx

Can you confirm owners and whether the proposed success criteria look right? If so we’ll schedule a 45-min kickoff for the week of 2/23 and send a pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
